requirements.title: Defined binary operators occupy the lowest expression precedence layer
requirements.definition: An expr is a level-5 expression optionally involving defined binary operators, and defined binary operators have the lowest operator precedence. Thus intrinsic numeric, character, relational, and logical layers bind inside the operands of defined binary operations unless parentheses alter grouping.

pending.level-5-base: PENDING positive-control source shape using a logical level-5 expression as a complete expr with a logical literal oracle and no defined binary operator.
pending.defined-binary-after-intrinsic: PENDING positive-control source shape a+b .op. c*d with a defined binary operator function returning a literal-distinguishable value based on its two integer arguments. The oracle distinguishes intrinsic operations performed as operands before the defined binary call.
pending.defined-binary-left-chain: PENDING positive-control source shape x .op. y .op. z with a defined binary function whose result makes left grouping observable by a literal oracle. This isolates R1023 left recursion and lowest precedence.
pending.parenthesized-defined-binary-operand: PENDING positive-control source shape x .op. (y .op. z) with a literal oracle different from the unparenthesized chain, demonstrating that parentheses can provide a defined-binary expression as the right operand through a primary.

requirements.oracle: Future precedence controls must use valid defined-operation interfaces and literal-distinguishable results; generic dispatch and operation interpretation remain dependencies.

requirements.title: An expr is a level-5 expression optionally preceded by an expr and defined binary operator
requirements.definition: The expr syntax is a level-5-expr or an expr followed by defined-binary-op and level-5-expr. This makes unparenthesized defined binary operations left-recursive and lower precedence than all intrinsic operator levels.

pending.single-level-5: PENDING positive-control source shape with a numeric or logical level-5 expression used as expr and checked against a literal oracle.
pending.defined-binary-operation: PENDING positive-control source shape defining OPERATOR(.join.) for two INTEGER operands and using 1 .join. 2 with a literal function-result oracle. R1024/C1006 own the token validity.
pending.left-recursive-defined-binary: PENDING positive-control source shape 1 .join. 2 .join. 3 with a function such as left*10+right and literal oracle 123 under left grouping. A parenthesized right-grouping companion yields a different literal.
pending.right-defined-binary-requires-parenthese: PENDING positive boundary source shape comparing a valid unparenthesized left-recursive chain x .op. y .op. z with a valid parenthesized right operand x .op. (y .op. z), using a defined binary function with literal-distinguishable nonassociative results. Both sources must have applicable specific procedures; no rejection is attributed to R1023. If the unparenthesized chain fails only because the second defined operation has no applicable specific procedure, that failure belongs to 10.1.6 and 15.4.3.4.2, not to R1023 syntax.
pending.missing-right-level-5-rejected: PENDING diagnostic/control source shape ending an expression with a valid defined-binary-op after a valid left expr. Repair appends a literal level-5 operand and observes the defined function's literal result, isolating R1023 syntax.

requirements.oracle: Only malformed expression form, such as a missing right level-5 operand after a valid defined-binary-op, is an R1023 syntax negative. Boundary plans for right grouping are positive comparisons using parentheses and applicable defined operations; generic resolution or non-applicability failures are dependencies owned by 10.1.6 and 15.4.3.4.2.

requirements.title: A defined binary operator is a dotted sequence of letters
requirements.definition: The defined-binary-op spelling is a period, one or more letters, and a period. Digits, underscores, missing dots, and empty names are not part of this syntactic form.

pending.single-letter: PENDING positive-control source shape defining OPERATOR(.b.) for two operands and observing a literal result from x .b. y.
pending.multiple-letters: PENDING positive-control source shape defining OPERATOR(.union.) and observing a literal-distinguishable function result; the letters-only dotted spelling is credited to R1024.
pending.missing-leading-dot-rejected: PENDING diagnostic/control source shape using b. between two valid operands in a defined-binary context. Repair to .b. observes a literal result, isolating R1024 leading-dot syntax.
pending.missing-trailing-dot-rejected: PENDING diagnostic/control source shape using .b between two valid operands, repaired to .b. with a literal oracle. The spelling otherwise uses valid letters.
pending.digit-in-name-rejected: PENDING diagnostic/control source shape using .b1. between two valid operands with a repair to .ba. and literal oracle. The violation is R1024 letters-only syntax, not C1006 length or reserved spelling.

requirements.oracle: Malformed spelling negatives are R1024. Excessive length and reserved intrinsic/logical spellings are C1006 even though they are dotted-letter sequences.

requirements.title: Defined binary operator names are short and not intrinsic or logical-literal spellings
requirements.definition: A defined-binary-op shall not contain more than 63 letters and shall not be the same as any intrinsic-operator or logical-literal-constant. This restriction mirrors C1005 for the binary operator grammar but is separately owned here.

pending.sixty-three-letter-control: PENDING positive-control source shape with a 63-letter dotted defined binary operator and a two-argument function returning a literal result. The fixture metadata counts letters independently and the oracle is the function result.
pending.sixty-four-letter-rejected: PENDING diagnostic/control source shape identical to the 63-letter binary control except for one added letter. Repair removes the added letter and observes the literal result, isolating C1006 length.
pending.intrinsic-operator-spelling-rejected: PENDING diagnostic/control source shape attempting a dotted intrinsic spelling such as .AND. or symbolic intrinsic equivalent where R1024 dotted-letter syntax is otherwise met for a defined-binary-op. Repair to .andx. observes a literal result; the violation is C1006 reserved spelling, not R1024.
pending.logical-true-spelling-rejected: PENDING diagnostic/control source shape attempting .TRUE. as a defined-binary-op name with otherwise valid two-argument interface. Repair to .truex. observes a literal result, isolating C1006 logical-literal exclusion.
pending.logical-false-spelling-rejected: PENDING diagnostic/control source shape attempting .FALSE. as a defined-binary-op name with otherwise valid two-argument interface. Repair to .falsex. observes a literal result, isolating C1006.

requirements.oracle: C1006 negatives must retain R1024 dotted-letter syntax and a valid binary defined-operation context; malformed spellings and wrong arity belong elsewhere.
